statement.text: Starting from any odd positive integer n, independently at each step choose odd(3n+1) or odd(3n−1), each with probability 1/2, where odd(m) is the odd part of m. Prove that the resulting process reaches 1 with probability 1 for every starting value.

title: Althöfer Prize 0: stochastic 3n±1 convergence
